glossEn: give or assign a resource to a particular person or cause
note: give or assign a resource to a particular person or cause。允许某人拥有某资源（钱、权限、时间）。allow sb sth / allow sb to do sth。

glossEn: allow or plan for a certain possibility; concede the truth or validity of something
note: allow or plan for a certain possibility; concede the truth or validity of something。线索：allow for / allow that + 从句，强调「把某种可能性算进去」。We must allow for delays.

glossEn: grant as a discount or in exchange
note: grant as a discount or in exchange。线索：宾语是折扣或交换物。The shop allows 10% discount to students.

glossEn: allow the presence of or allow (an activity) without opposing or prohibiting
note: [WORDNET 补缺 ECDICT 未收录] WORDNET 补缺 allow the presence of or allow (an activity) without opposing or prohibiting。不禁止而允许某人在场或某事进行。Smoking is not allowed in the hall.
